description: This Java class 'ReadingGoalController' is a Spring Boot REST controller that manages reading goals within a book tracking application. It provides endpoints for creating, deleting, and retrieving reading goals related to pages or books, using HTTP methods such as POST, GET, and DELETE.

classes.name: ReadingGoalController
classes.description: A REST controller for managing reading goals, including creating, deleting, and retrieving goals related to pages or books.

classes.name: ReadingGoalController.Endpoints
classes.description: A static inner class that defines URI endpoints for the ReadingGoalController.

methods.name: deleteReadingGoal
methods.description: Handles DELETE requests to remove all reading goals.

methods.name: addBookReadingGoal
methods.description: Handles POST requests to add a reading goal based on the number of books.

methods.name: addPagesReadingGoal
methods.description: Handles POST requests to add a reading goal based on pages.

methods.name: getPreviousReadingGoals
methods.description: Handles GET requests to retrieve all previous reading goals.

methods.name: getExistingReadingGoal
methods.description: Handles GET requests to retrieve the current active reading goal.
